fact: In October 2026 the ONECI director general said CityWeb, a centralised computerised civil registration system, is deployed in all civil registration centres of Côte d'Ivoire and that register digitisation covers all centres, with an online platform for birth, marriage and death records presented to officers.
title: Côte d’Ivoire : L’ONECI instruit les officiers d’état civil sur la Plateforme digitale de demande et d’obtention en ligne des actes d’état civil
